description: About the Hackathon: Welcome to the Agentic AI Development Hackathon 2026 , organised by Proton Solutions . This hackathon challenges participants to explore the potential of Agentic Artificial Intelligence through hands-on development and innovation. Registered participants will receive a starter AI Agent source file via email. Their task is to analyse the provided agent, understand its architecture and existing capabilities, and further develop, enhance, or extend its functionalities to create a more efficient and intelligent AI-powered solution. Participants are encouraged to demonstrate their technical skills, creativity, problem-solving abilities, and understanding of autonomous AI agents. The competition will focus on how effectively participants understand the provided code, implement improvements, introduce innovative features, and demonstrate the performance of their developed agents. What Participants Will Do: Receive and analyse the provided AI Agent source file. Understand its architecture, workflow, and existing functionalities. Identify limitations and opportunities for improvement. Develop and enhance the agent with additional capabilities. Test and validate the developed solution. Submit the completed source code along with technical documentation and a demonstration. Who Can Participate? Students, developers, AI enthusiasts, researchers, and technology innovators interested in Artificial Intelligence, Agentic AI, automation, and software development. Organised By: Proton Solutions Build. Innovate. Automate. Experience the future of Agentic AI!

About the Hackathon:

Welcome to the Agentic AI Development Hackathon 2026, organised by Proton Solutions.

This hackathon challenges participants to explore the potential of Agentic Artificial Intelligence through hands-on development and innovation.

Registered participants will receive a starter AI Agent source file via email. Their task is to analyse the provided agent, understand its architecture and existing capabilities, and further develop, enhance, or extend its functionalities to create a more efficient and intelligent AI-powered solution.

Participants are encouraged to demonstrate their technical skills, creativity, problem-solving abilities, and understanding of autonomous AI agents.

The competition will focus on how effectively participants understand the provided code, implement improvements, introduce innovative features, and demonstrate the performance of their developed agents.

What Participants Will Do:

  • Receive and analyse the provided AI Agent source file.
  • Understand its architecture, workflow, and existing functionalities.
  • Identify limitations and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop and enhance the agent with additional capabilities.
  • Test and validate the developed solution.
  • Submit the completed source code along with technical documentation and a demonstration.

Who Can Participate?

  • Students, developers, AI enthusiasts, researchers, and technology innovators interested in Artificial Intelligence, Agentic AI, automation, and software development.

Organised By:

Proton Solutions

Build. Innovate. Automate. Experience the future of Agentic AI!
